description: Government data shows coverage has expanded to 4.78 lakh employees across 42 departments, with registrations rising from 2.46 lakh to 3.01 lakh in a week and daily attendance increasing from 1.85 lakh to 2.32 lakh
body_lead: Karnataka's indigenous AI-powered attendance management platform, Kartavya (Karnataka Advanced Attendance Management System, or KAAMS), has recorded a sharp increase in employee registrations and attendance across government departments, according to data released by the state government on June 15. Developed in-house by the Centre for e-Governance (CeG) and Karnataka AI Cell under Department of Personnel and Administrative Reforms (e-Governance), the platform now covers 4.78 lakh employees across 42 departments.
